name: gh-project-authors
title_zh: 仓库署名页：谁写的、谁在维护、许可证白话版
tagline_zh: 接手别人的项目，先想知道这库谁在管、还能不能提 issue。它从 GitHub MCP 拉出 owner、原作者。
tagline_en: Before you file an issue, know who owns the repo, who maintains it now, how many contributors there are, and what.
desc_en: Writes the WHO section of a non-technical GitHub onboarding report: owner, original author, current maintainers, number of contributors, license explained in plain words, from facts.authors collected through the GitHub MCP. Used by /onboard-project.
why_zh: 它只写 WHO 这一节，不碰架构也不碰安装。许可证不抄原文，直接说「你能改、能商用。
why_en: It writes only the WHO section — no architecture, no setup. Licenses aren't quoted, they're translated into 'you can modify.
limit_zh: 只产出 WHO 一节，架构、安装、贡献指南都不管；依赖 GitHub MCP 已连上并能读到 facts.author…
limit_en: Only the WHO section — no architecture, setup, or contribution guide. Requires GitHub MCP with facts.authors access; private repos without auth.
title_en: Repo credits page: who wrote it, who maintains it, license.
